In collaboration with indie game publisher Playism, the Nintendo Switch version of Chrono Ark is scheduled for release on January 29, 2026!

The game will support the same languages as the PC version and will include all DLC (Summer Twilight, High Roller).

The First Limited Package Edition is now available for pre-order, while the digital download version and standard package version will be released at a later date.

The First Limited Package Edition comes with a 70-page artbook and is available in limited quantities.

Hello everyone.

This is the director of Chrono Ark, Hyung-Ju Lee.

After four years of Early Access, the official release is finally here!
It's all thanks to the Tumblbug crowdfunding, the YouTuber '타코리뷰' (now '지식한입'), Steam's Early Access feature, Bilibili's '怕上火暴王老菊', '独立游戏蜥蜴君', and '少年Pi', and all of you players. Without any one of these, this project would have been impossible.

Summer Twilight Store Page
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/63038b2b00bbe9feb2cdeeb59b3e0851cfa21f02.png








And... It's time to introduce our next project after Chrono Ark.


Deception Engine
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/d738c3560c2656248906cfd10daa327c0523b035.png

Deck Building Heist RPG

Story
11 cities and engines, the end of the world, betrayal, infiltration, and... a heist.

The criminal organization 'Engine Raiders' that aims to steal the 'engines', the heart of each city, to revive the 'City of Domination'. And the city 'Utopia' that faces against them. 
And the 'protagonist', a spy of 'Utopia', disgused as a chief member of the 'Engine Raiders'.
Their story now begins.

System
'Deception Engine' will feature a combat system similar to 'Chrono Ark', but more refined. There will be combat visuals and dungeon progression. (A heist!)
There will also be a base management system reminiscent of 'Darkest Dungeon, XCOM', and a suspenseful noir-esque story.

Stay tuned for more information!











Thoughts on Chrono Ark Development
This is only my personal story as the 'Developer Hyung-Ju Lee', and it's not related to the game, so there's no need for you to read it.

Hello everyone. I am Hyung-Ju Lee, a developer of Chrono Ark and alfine.

It's been a long journey.
After 3 years of development and 4 years of Early Access, Chrono Ark is finally complete.

Actually, Chrono Ark is my 2nd project.

What was the first project?
Well... it was a failed project.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FDAvURHrU0A

This first project, which I programmed in my third year of high school, failed. I was devastated and spent 1 year of doing nothing, but then I finally decided to give game development one last try, which led to 'Chrono Ark'.

When I first started developing Chrono Ark, I was working part-time at a convenience store. I worked on the game in an unheated alcove, with a laptop on the floor and a blanket over my head, with nothing but a dream to make a fun game once more.

After a long development period, there were only two team members remaining when we launched the game in Early Access, including myself.

We launched the game in Early Access as a 2-member team, and then used the profits to recruit more team members and develop the game further... In the midst of it all, I became ambitious and wanted to include a lot of things, so I tried this and that. 
This process delayed the game by a lot.

And finally! Chrono Ark is now officially released.

I feel a little older now.

I recognize that there was both good and bad updates during the development of Chrono Ark.

I learned what people like, what people don't like, why the development period was so delayed, and what I can do well.
Based on my experience in developing Chrono Ark, I want to make an even better next game!

Thank you.

We’ve originally announced Chrono Ark’s release date to be April 26th, 2024, but as mentioned, we've decided to push back the release date by one week to accommodate the release discount, which means the game will be set to launch on May 3rd, 2024.

We apologize for going back on our previously announced schedule.

notes.title: Chrono Ark EA 2.02 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Hyung-Ju Lee, the director of Chrono Ark.
Chrono Ark has been updated to EA version 2.02.

Main Features

Opened all Investigators' Token of Friendship
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/0722828755878d5cc6970491a8099cbf81de16fe.png

We've updated the game so that you can now obtain all Investigators' Token of Friendship.
Also, we've speeded up the process of building Token of Friendship by allowing the player to gift items to Investigators in all campfires.

Opened Golden Token of Friendship
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/d4b1be3e477c20348699a944a269776d60385728.png

The Golden Token of Friendship you could only obtain with Phoenix is now open to all Investigators.
However, there are some special Investigators whose Golden Token of Friendship you cannot obtain yet.
You can obtain Golden Token of Friendship by first gaining the Red Token of Friendship in the Archive, then talking to the Investigator in the final area.
There are no gameplay perks to having Golden Token of Friendship, but in the upcoming ending, you'll be required to have Golden Token of Friendship with at least 1 party member.

Patch Notes

System
- Implemented all Investigators' Token of Friendship
- Implemented Investigators' Golden Token of Friendship
- Increased the number of retries from 1 to 3 when failing a certain storyline. Also, retries are now available in the Crimson Wilderness segment of the story.
- Overall improvements to skill text.
- Greatly improved Gamepad controls.
- Accelerate+ is no longer guaranteed to appear in the Fountain of Wishes, and it now costs an additional 300 Gold to obtain.
- Reduced the number of keys required to enter Crimson Wilderness from 2->1.
- Workshop - (Beta) Added a mod editor. The mod editor can be accessed through the Workshop Menu in the Main Menu.

- (Japanese) story text has been improved, and Phoenix's first-person pronoun has been changed.
Thank you to everyone who helped improve the Japanese translation.

notes.notes:
Hello, Fellow Arkers! Chrono Ark has officially been updated with v1.7 content.

In this new update, we have added a large amount of player choices outside of battle.
This update provides many new ways to strengthen your party, and one of the main methods is our new Skill Upgrade system!
There are also many new monsters, new items, and new skills to seek out.
All system changes have been completed with this update, and all that’s left is to keep adding more content!

A huge thanks to all the beta players who reported bugs and provided valuable playtest feedback.

First of all, let’s look at what has changed since v1.63.

Improved Field Objects
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/036d3d2f4a3a8ae70f2e674f33217d982fe96b58.gif
Field objects have been completely reworked, and there are now 42 events implemented in the game.
Not all event objects have been implemented, and there will be more to come in future updates.
Along with the massive increase in object count, there are now many new ways to obtain items as well as a variety of new items.
 
Addition of Choices
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/30a69999876b7d3d0aee744129468df26f4bde0d.gif
When obtaining lower-tier equipment, there are now many cases where you can pick between 2 displayed items.
There are also many cases where you can make a choice between 2 Relics.

Skill Upgrades
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/92d4b281c6046875c58bdbdb8d8ee39246e6797a.gif

notes.title: Feedback Reports from the Community and Update Plans
notes.notes:
1. “I have played Chrono Ark: Fate and the genre is too different from the original game and has too much play time!”

Alternative Solution: The game is now clearable without watching the ending of Chrono Ark: Fate
The game currently plays Lucy’s story where the Prologue of Chrono Ark: Fate is supposed to be.
Chrono Ark: Fate can be unlocked and viewed under a certain condition.


Our first intention was to make players watch the Prologue only for Chrono Ark: Fate and let them choose to watch the rest. Now you can choose whether to choose to watch the Prologue or not.


We considered that players would remain curious about the rest of the story after clearing the game without watching Chrono Ark: Fate. So, we decided not to force everyone to go through the plots.

The reason why we decided to build Chrono Ark: Fate is because I, as a director, personally do not like resolving remaining questions into a separate series.


There are many short but emotional stories about Lucy to come. Please wait for them to be added patiently.


Also, new PV and trailer for Chrono Ark are planned to be added around the time the second series of Chrono Ark: Fate is on!



2. “Please Balance out the Skills!”

We are planning massive buffs and nerfs.

"Charon’s skill set is just mediocre."
- Charon will receive her Rare skill. Her new core mechanic will be upgraded while dealing additional damage when Soul Stigma is applied to the target.

​
"Azar’s Illusion Flash is too hard to use. Fantasy is too overpowered."
- We will nerf Fantasy and remove the Count effect from Azar’s Illusion Flash.

"Hein depends on Merciless Explosion. His other skills sucks with low Accuracy. It’s impossible to use Hein without Merciless Explostion."
- We will buff Hein’s skills based on Merciless Explosion’s health-based self-harming mechanic. We will also add extra effects to skills such as Tear Up and Assault Slash to suggest a new concept to Hein players.

"Most of the Rare skills of Silverstein, Narhan, and most of the Healers suck."
- We will improve on all Rare skills mentioned above..

​
"Lian and Phoenix don’t have any Draw Skills?"
- We will add them for both.

​

Others:

Selena and Helia’s Blessing-based skills - Planned to be buffed

Lian’s Relentless Swipe - Planned to be nerfed

Trisha - Planned to fix Blink Stab’s OTK mechanic. Planned to improve on ‘boring’ skills.

Miss Chain’s Fire Ground - Planned to be buffed
​


Everything that are mentioned above is our next goal. We will update ASAP!

We stream our dev progress on Twitch. You can hang out with us by clicking the link above!
